UC-1205.note: New. The change note (Clauseo changed N papers) lists each paper on its own row; a spreadsheet it changed (.xlsx, .xls) that the wall lists has this press beside it, which opens it with the computer's default app through open_file. Before, the note offered only Open in Word, for exactly one Word document, so a spreadsheet the answer made had no way to open (Windows tester, Westlake).
